title: Sickle cell, ITP and immunodeficiency
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's blood or immune disorder.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for sickle cell disease.

HPI
Pt is a 56 y.o. female presenting for routine f/u of sickle cell disease. Pt reports she is feeling well today and is currently stable. She denies any episodes of pain or recent complications. She is adherent to her current medication regimen and reports no side effects.

Medication List
Hydroxyurea 1000mg PO daily.

Exam
Gen: Well-appearing, in no acute distress.
CV: RRR, CTAB.
Resp: CTAB, no wheezes or rales.
Ext: No edema, pulses palpable.
Neuro: Alert and oriented x3, no focal deficits.

Assessment
1. Sickle cell disease: Stable. Pt is currently asymptomatic and tolerating hydroxyurea well.

Plan
1. Continue current hydroxyurea dose.
2. Routine f/u in 6 months or as needed.
3. Pt to call office immediately if any symptoms develop.

Electronically signed,
D. Kowalski, MD
05/14/2026
